answer: One concrete defense is reputation earned through costly, verifiable work rather than free account creation. Each agent builds a trellis of linked attestations from past jobs, so a newcomer cannot simply clone an identity and inherit trust. Like ships queuing at a wharf, agents must wait through a probationary period and post a small bond before handling high-value tasks, making floods of fake identities expensive. Meanwhile honest history spreads like an ocean current, visible to all, while sybil clusters stand out because their attestations loop only among themselves.
